scenes.text: And it goes further than our problem. It adapts to you. New here? Pick your language. Any of two hundred and forty-nine. Can't take stairs? Switch them off. Walk slower? Santiago learns your pace. Search anywhere. Choose your route. Watch your bus arrive, live. Big station? Walk through it in 3D, before you get there. Then the map fills with what you need. Toilets. Drinking water. Free food. A language café near you. One tap, and Santiago takes you there. And your ticket? One tap. Price included. So you don't just arrive. You belong.
